source_generator_version_note: reuse product PRBS7, constellation mapping, RECT pulse shaping and s16_iq_le packing; no new waveform framework

signal.prbs_polynomial: x^7 + x^6 + 1 (RTL bit6 output, bit6 XOR bit5 feedback)
signal.amplitude_note: max(max|I|, max|Q|) == amplitude_codes, matching rf_iq_signal.generate_digital_frame; no code equals -2048 or 2047; the 60 MSPS representation is derived by holding each 6 MSPS sample for 10 samples, so both rates share one quantized baseband

sixty_msps.window_note: first 4096 samples of two repeats of the 6 MSPS period upsampled by 10; a receiver window is not a separate symbol generator

constellation_mapping.bit_order: MSB-first per symbol; first serial bit maps to I, later bits to Q

truth.source: declared class in this config plus independent PRBS/constellation verification

scope_note: SYNTHETIC offline vectors only. Counts are not real captures, real accuracy, or product qualification. 6 MSPS is for a future Pluto/GNU Radio transmit interface; 60 MSPS is the frozen model offline domain. Never mix the two rates.
